title: Portuguese-Style Grilled Chicken Salad
description: A refreshing salad featuring grilled chicken, cucumber, and a light Portuguese-inspired dressing.
instructions: 2. Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
3. Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
5. In a large bowl, combine the sliced cucumber, red onion, and chopped kale.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, and minced garlic.
7. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
8. Slice the grilled chicken and add it to the salad.
9. Toss the salad again to combine.
